The Predicted Answer states that Mount Saint Elias (USA, 1897) and Klyuchevskaya Sopka (Russia, 1788) are the correct mountains, and claims the difference in years between the first ascents is 109 years. The Ground Truth Answer claims the answer is 35 years. Therefore, the substance and vital facts of the Ground Truth Answer (35 years) are not present in the Predicted Answer.
